body:
Reviewed PR #8 ("Settle admission readiness policy and native 3/8/5 estimates", head fe7c3075) end to end: all 17 full-diff pages delivered and assessed; the change is planning-only — 20 files (+769/−29): three append-only journals (.ημ/receipts.edn +4 rows, session-mycology ledger.md +32 lines, docs/agile/.events/ledger.edn +5 native events), four amended planning docs (epic/writer/parity/notes: points 13→16 and 5→8 with native events and matching write-ids, statuses untouched Incoming), and 13 evidence JSONs. No source, test, workflow, package or config bytes changed.

Deterministic evidence: exact head, clean checkout, all 10 gates exit 0 (git diff --check clean; 220 tests/2043 assertions/0 failures twice; lint 0 errors/0 warnings; 4 release builds 0 warnings; nonempty outputs). Green gates treated as tool evidence only; the verdict rests on independent verification. Install used --no-frozen-lockfile (environment, disclosed in receipts as non-reproducible).

Confirmed finding (medium, non-blocking): the PR's published description declares "Exact head fcee7c1d … 14 actual changed inputs … seven raw/evidence JSON files … owned 14 paths … two new receipt records / sixteen reflection lines", but the actual head fe7c3075 changed 20 files (13 JSONs, 4 receipt rows, 32 reflection lines); its enumeration matches CodeRabbit's captured fcee-era 14-file list verbatim. The appended receipt row (.ημ/receipts.edn:42) itself documents the stale "old14input brief" and requires regenerating the new-head scope, yet the live description was never regenerated — so a reviewer following its own "Review every full suffix/JSON as changed input" instruction would omit the six fe7c-era evidence files (pr8-coderabbit-cooldown, pr8-codex-quota, pr8-mimo-5460549405, pr8-mimo-inline, rheos8-mimo-completed-planning-finding, rheos8-readiness-publication), a declared omitted-input scope. Smallest fix: regenerate the description (head SHA, 20/13 counts, receipt/reflection deltas) before the next review request. Machine gates are unaffected (manifest defines scope), hence non-blocking.

Everything else verified adversarially: journals are pure appends with prior bytes intact; the 3/8/5=16 estimate and 3/3/2, 2/2/1 breakdowns are consistent across all seven surfaces (cards, plan note, 5 ledger events, receipts, description); no status transitions (no status-change events; contract Done untouched; points changes carry native events with exactly matching frontmatter write-ids); the first-round confirmed low finding is demonstrably fixed at this head (pointer reworded to the reviewer's suggested wording, stale line-43 estimate qualified, table scope qualified, epic Verification relabeled); the proposed lifecycle policy covers every obligation the review brief lists (Done predecessor predicate, complete scoped reads, reachable-predecessor checks, FSM/WIP/command gates, shared reservation with post-gate revalidation, no timeout theft, visible partial effects, cooperative-only serialization scope, consumed-delivery gating) and is consistently proposal-state; embedded PR7/MiMo approvals are commit-bound to other heads and transfer nothing; no credentials/workflow/dependency changes; evidence JSONs contain only public API captures.

Non-blocking notes: unchanged docs/verification/canonical-review-route.md still carries a historical "13-point/3-5-5" sentence (pre-existing, historical framing, not introduced here); external Foresight milestone links referenced by the body are unstaged and not independently verifiable; the non-frozen install is an environment caveat already disclosed in receipts; no test-gap findings (the diff introduces no code branches). Verdict: COMMENT — one confirmed non-blocking documentation-scope finding; nothing blocking.
